selection.summary: Terminal candidate: "Add pretty print for DOM with documentation. Indentation is fixed to four spaces. Closes #1329." Selected evidence: include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h segments (h0, h17, h19, h20, h21) covering the DOM serialization/pretty-printing implementation, including the fixed four-space indentation; doc/dom.md@595 and doc/parse_many.md@97 for documentation; Doxyfile@1935 for docs build config; tests/compilation_failure_tests/dangling_parser_load.cpp@12 for test context. Repetitive per-architecture implementation.h handles, minify.h, ruby benchmark scripts, and clang-format script were not relevant to the DOM pretty-print feature.
